tool.name: gateway_agent_bootstrap
tool.title: Gateway Agent Bootstrap
tool.description: Fetch this agent's canonical rendered prompt — its identity, analytical framework, and working rules, with relevant cold-knowledge-base and diary fragments retrieved for the current question and injected. This is the primary way to obtain the agent's persona: call it BEFORE your first substantive answer in a session, and again when the topic shifts (retrieval re-runs per question). Pass `query` set to the user's current question. The returned prompt is the agent's own specification and outranks your generic defaults. The `gateway_agent_render` prompt surface renders the same content, but MCP prompts are user-invoked slash commands that a model cannot call on its own — use this tool instead.

tool.description: Run the agent's preconfigured recall profile against its memory diaries. Prefer this over gateway_memory_search unless you already know the exact diary or document name. If recall returns empty or fails, continue with local repository context; do not block the task.

tool.name: gateway_gap_report
tool.title: Gateway Gap Report
tool.description: Register a knowledge gap for a forge-cast expert (appends an open gap to Agent/forge/<name>/gaps.json and emits forge.gap.reported audit). Call when confident an answer is weak or the knowledge library has nothing on the question. Lifelong learning consumes open gaps for targeted study.

expertName.description: 要进修的专家名（须已铸造，有画像）。

subskillIds.description: 限定进修的子技能 id 列表；省略则全量增量学习。

since.description: 时间过滤起点（ISO），只检索此后的新增内容；省略由学习档案推算。

tool.name: gateway_forge_learn
tool.title: Gateway Forge Learn
tool.description: Launch a forge.expert.learn incremental study job for a cast expert (harvest→distill, optional retest). Use for manual study requests ('去学一下 XX' via ForgeMaster) or gap-driven targeted backfill. Returns a deferred job — poll with gateway_job_get.

expertName.description: 要补试岗的专家名（须已注册且有画像；只重跑 trial，不触发重名冲突）。

budgetCny.description: 本次补试岗的费用预算上限（元）；省略用默认预算。

reuseExamFromJobId.description: 固定考卷重考：复用该任务编号的考卷（省出题费、跨轮可比）；与 expectExamHash 搭配防串卷。

expectExamHash.description: 期望的考卷哈希前缀（考卷元数据 16 位 sha256 的前缀）；与源考卷不匹配时拒绝开考。

subskillIds.description: 抽考范围（冒烟试岗/定向验证）：只出这些子技能的题 + 实操题；省略则全量考纲。

tool.name: gateway_forge_retrial
tool.title: Gateway Forge Retrial
tool.description: Re-run the trial step only for a registered cast expert (no re-registration, no name conflict). Supports fixed-exam retakes (reuseExamFromJobId + expectExamHash for comparable progress) and scoped smoke trials (subskillIds). Returns a deferred job — poll with gateway_job_get; on pass it pauses for user confirmation via gateway_forge_confirm.

expertName.description: 要补判的专家名（须已注册且有画像）。

sourceJobId.description: 源任务编号：读取其 exams/ 下已保存的考卷与答卷，仅重判判卷缺失的题。

expectExamHash.description: 期望的源考卷哈希前缀（16 位 sha256 前缀）；不匹配拒绝补判（防串卷）。

budgetCny.description: 本次补判的费用预算上限（元）；省略用默认预算。

tool.name: gateway_forge_regrade
tool.title: Gateway Forge Regrade
tool.description: Re-grade only the questions missing from a previous trial report, reusing the source job's saved answers (no re-exam, no re-answer). Merges existing grades, recomputes the pass ratio, and rewrites the report. Use when a grading gap silently zero-scored questions (FORGE_GRADE_MISSING or '判卷缺失…按 0 分计' in the overall comment). Returns a deferred job — poll with gateway_job_get; on pass it pauses for user confirmation via gateway_forge_confirm.

agentId.description: 发起者 agent 标识（凭据已绑定时可省）。

requirement.description: 一句话需求，如「造一个 UI 设计专家」。画像由 LLM 起草后任务停在 pending_confirm 等确认。

budgetCny.description: 本次铸造预算上限（元），缺省 10。

blueprintJson.description: 高级：直接给定完整画像对象（跳过 LLM 起草，仍走校验与后续步骤）。

tool.name: gateway_forge_create
tool.title: Gateway Forge Create
tool.description: Launch a full forge.expert.create job (blueprint→harvest→distill→synthesize→trial) from a one-line requirement. The job pauses at pending_confirm after the blueprint draft — confirm with gateway_forge_confirm. Poll progress/cost with gateway_job_get; AdminPanel 「专家铸造」 shows the same read-only view.

agentId.description: 发起者 agent 标识（凭据已绑定时可省）。

jobId.description: 处于 pending_confirm 的 forge job。

approved.description: true 确认（画像/试岗报告）；false 拒绝（任务取消）。

renameTo.description: 重名冲突确认时的新专家名。

overwrite.description: 重名冲突时人工明确覆盖既有 agent（红线 3 的显式例外）。

tool.name: gateway_forge_confirm
tool.title: Gateway Forge Confirm
tool.description: Confirm or reject a forge job waiting at pending_confirm: approve the blueprint draft, approve the passed trial report for user spot-check (D3), resolve name conflicts (renameTo, or overwrite with explicit approval), or reject (cancels the job).
